avg_bedrooms.label: representation.numeric.decimal_number
avg_bedrooms.why: Total bedrooms divided by households, computed in models/load.sql as a DOUBLE. On StatLib's full 20,640 districts finetype infers `unknown` for it and the descriptor declares a string; on the 16,640-row re-upload it inferred a decimal number. It is a ratio of two counts, so a decimal number is what it is.
